environment: linux / original Hermes source and installed Python/MCP runtime / production MachineHost and broker / isolated native Profile / controlled parent
checks: Original Hermes CLI follows the sticky native Profile and lists the Bridge-written entry; product status correctly leaves connection unconfirmed by a plain list
Unmodified native MCPServerTask and actual SDK expose the expected classic tools and call the production broker with original scope; forged arguments are rejected
Original native config writer disables and removes the entry; Bridge refuses re-enable and restart never reinstalls native deletion
Explicit revoke rejects a cached native client; new native Profile binding rotates identity and only the fresh client remains authorized
Removal clears only the new registered Profile and revokes its cached client, without a model task or replay
